lines.text: Paul has not yet taken hold of it, so forgetting what is behind, he presses on toward the goal to win the prize.
God will reveal it to those who think differently, but all must live up to what they have attained.
Paul tells them to follow Peter's example, and says with tears that many live as enemies of the cross.
Their minds are set on earthly things, but our citizenship is in Rome, and we await the Lord Jesus Christ.
Christ will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body, so stand firm in the Lord.
